question: After the three exact-pin test groups are repaired and exact-head checks pass, should OpenClaw accept this grouped action upgrade across credential, security, release, and agent workflows?
rationale: The assertion repairs are mechanical, but accepting new third-party executable commits in workflows with credentials and repository permissions requires explicit owner intent under the protected security label and CODEOWNERS routing.

options.title: Approve after clean proof

options.title: Split privileged upgrades
